author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Ninety-Four! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Night has fallen and you're trapped with a wounded friend in a grim castle. The Giant that calls it home is hunting you, but was blinded in the fight. Your only hope for you and your friend is to kill the fiend as it tracks you by sound. This one-player adventure game includes everything you need to play, with the option of printable STLS and Terrain as well. Let's check it out!

This feature is dedicated to Cael whose health has been a struggle over the past few weeks. Lots of love to them and their family from me and the whole GMG Community.

Check out the PRINT AND PLAY game rules and models  HERE: https://bardswordpress.itch.io/defiance-duel-in-the-black-keep
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 094 - DEFIANCE: Duel in the Black Keep by Cael J. Amari
